thread:
kevin: throwing up a quick design thread for streaming session handoffs across hosted/dedicated/private. problem: long-running streams (chat, streaming tokens) may need to be moved or retried on a different runtime without dropping the client's session or losing KV cache.
maria: curious about primary motivators. is this about scaling, node failure, or tenant migration?
kevin: all of the above. examples: dedicated pool saturated -> move some streams to hosted fallback; runtime eviction on upgrade; customer migrates from hosted to private and wants existing sessions to continue.
aj: big constraints: auth/credentials, KV cache continuity (latents), and avoiding re-sending large prefix contexts. plus private installs may forbid outbound callbacks.
sara: security note: we can't leak ephemeral KV or caches between tenants or across trust domains. any handoff must preserve tenant isolation and auditability.
kevin: proposed primitive: "stream-checkpoint" — lightweight, signed checkpoint describing minimal replay state: seq_num, small KV-hash, model_pos, route_hint, verifier_sig, checkpoint_id. new runtime can request a checkpoint payload from origin runtime or from control plane (if allowed). for private, runtime must persist checkpoints locally and share only with approved peers.
maria: so handoff flow sketches: 1) preemptive dual-write: origin runtime writes checkpoint to durable store (config-sync or local persistent store) and marks it available, 2) new runtime pulls checkpoint, verifies signature, resumes stream from seq_num with optional delta-resume to avoid full prefix resend.
aj: question: where is the canonical store? hosted can use control plane blobstore; dedicated could use internal durable cache; private must use local store accessible to allowed runtimes. we need abstract storage backends in runtime layer.
kevin: yes, runtime-storage-adapter with three modes: cp-blob (hosted), shared-network-volume (dedicated), local-persist (private). implementation details differ but API identical: put_checkpoint(id, payload), get_checkpoint(id), delete_checkpoint(id).
sara: what about live-inflight tokens and streaming auth renewal mid-stream? we should carry a short-lived "handoff-assertion" signed by origin to let new runtime accept the client without full rebind. it could be similar to the signed-lease but scoped to the session.
maria: handoff-assertion fields: session_id, issuer_runtime_id, issued_at, expiry, checkpoint_id, sig. verification uses pinned runtime pubkeys from manifest. if runtime pubkey rotation occurs, handoffs must fall back to control plane validation.
aj: operational concerns: we must bound checkpoint size to avoid huge object transfer. recommend storing only metadata + small base64 of KV delta (limit 64KB) and require larger prefixes to be cached via prefix-sharing heuristics.
kevin: streaming continuity: two resume modes: reconstructive-resume (client resends last N tokens to catch up; cheap but client-visible) and native-resume (new runtime reconstructs internal KV by applying a compact delta; seamless if available). prefer native for low-latency UX.
sara: privacy: never include raw user inputs in checkpoint; only include content hashes or short tokenized deltas with customer opt-in. audits should allow mapping checkpoint_id -> runtime actions but not reveal prompt content.
maria: failure modes: checkpoint pull failure, signature mismatch, clock skew expiry, missing storage adapter. define fallback: if native-resume fails -> attempt reconstructive-resume -> if that fails -> surface ephemeral error and offer client reconnect path. log detailed reason codes.
aj: metrics we need: handoff.attempts, handoff.success_rate, handoff.latency_ms, handoff.fail_reason counts, checkpoint.size_distribution, storage_adapter_errors. console view should show active sessions with checkpoint age and last_handoff_reason.
kevin: rollout: feature-flag streaming-handoff-v1. runtime changes: verifier lib, storage-adapter interface, checkpoint serializer, and streaming client library update to handle optional native-resume handshake. control plane: optional checkpoint blobstore + permission mappings. docs: migration guide for private installs (local persist config).
infra-bot: ops checklist: - add runtime storage-adapter interface and initial cp-blob + local-persist implementations - add checkpoint signer/verifier lib (rotate keys via KMS) - implement checkpoint size limits + eviction policy - add streaming client handshake support (resume negotiation) - add console telemetry + handoff dashboard - perf tests for checkpoint transfer latency at 99th percentile - security review for cross-mode assertion acceptance
sara: one more: ensure legal/enterprise compliance by allowing tenants to opt-out of cross-host handoffs (force session failover only within same trust domain). add tenant manifest flag: allow_cross_host_handoff: true/false.
maria: nice. let's capture this in a short RFC: define checkpoint schema, handoff assertion format, storage adapter API, privacy rules, failure handling, and rollout plan. i'll draft and tag infra/security for review.
aj: please include example protobuf/JSON schemas and a minimal pseudo-code for resume handshake.
kevin: will draft code snippets and initial perf numbers. thanks all.
